sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

def snap(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n')
    lp=sum(1 for r in range(49,60) for c in range(11,21) if a[r][c]=='p')
    rg=sum(1 for r in range(46,60) for c in range(22,34) if a[r][c]=='W')
    knob=None
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b':
            b=n['boundary']; cs=[p[1] for p in b]; rs=[p[0] for p in b]
            if 10<=min(cs)<=25 and min(rs)>=17 and (max(rs)-min(rs))>=4: knob=(min(cs),max(cs))
    return dict(leftP=lp,rightW=rg,knob=knob)
print("before:",snap(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':50,'col':12}],intent='explore')
print("after :",snap(current_frame))
print("result:",{k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ['board_changed','gameplay_changed','no_impact','level_completed','done'] if k in last_action_result})
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
